items.reply: I retain FP/none: the main topic title's floated bullet retains its 5px margin, while the removed margin affects the header category rendered below its heading with newly adjusted line-height. The reviewer's assertion that order(2) works is incorrect: header-extra-info retains Ember's default component wrapper, so .extra-info-wrapper is not a direct flex child of .contents. That ineffective order does not establish the claimed bullet alignment defect.
